app.name: TW-AMR Watch
app.tagline: Taiwan's national antimicrobial-resistance, antibiotic-use and healthcare-associated infection surveillance — in one place.

footer.sourcesBody: Taiwan CDC annual surveillance reports (Taiwan Healthcare-associated infection and Antimicrobial resistance Surveillance System, THAS) and WHO GLASS. Values are transcribed from the published reports; see Methodology for precision notes.
footer.disclaimerBody: TW-AMR Watch is an independent visualization project and is not an official publication of Taiwan CDC or WHO. It is not medical advice. Always consult the original reports before citing figures.
footer.license: Code MIT · Data per original source terms

provisional.chipHint: Curated estimate modelled on published trends — not official figures.
provisional.title: Provisional estimates
provisional.body: This section uses curated estimates modelled on published Taiwan CDC trends until the official annual report is added. Do not cite these numbers as official.
provisional.siteBody: Some sections (antibiotic use, HAI, international comparison) still show provisional estimates. Resistance data are transcribed from the Taiwan CDC annual reports.

precision.label: Precision
precision.tableHint: Transcribed exactly from a numeric table in the report.
precision.chart_estimateHint: Estimated from a printed chart; accurate to about ±1–2 percentage points.

fixture.hint: Showing bundled development data because public/data could not be loaded.
